facility_name: Brooklyn Sky Child Care Center Inc.

inspections.violation_description: Constant and competent supervision provided by adequate staff for children and groups of children

violations.description: Constant and competent supervision provided by adequate staff for children and groups of children
Child care service teaching staff acting as assistant teachers do Not meet age and educational requirements.

inspections.violation_description: N permittee shall admit a child without appropriate documentation of immunization or medical exemption

violations.description: N permittee shall admit a child without appropriate documentation of immunization or medical exemption

Staff and volunteers obtain documentation showing immunization with 2 doses measles/mumps, 1 dose rubella, 2 doses varicella and 1 dose Tdap. Medical exemptions only. History of measles, mumps or rubella shall Not replace MMR vaccine except in presence of MMR varicella antibodies.

inspections.inspection_outcome: Reinspection Required; Violations corrected at time of inspection

inspections.violation_description: Child care service fails to provide two means of egress.

violations.description: Child care service fails to provide two means of egress.
Permittee transferred/sold permit to unauthorized entity/individual; permittee changed address without applying for new permit.
Child care service providing care without a staff member trained in First Aid/CPR on site at time of inspection.
Qualified Group Teacher Not designated to cover for Education Director. Permittee failed to Notify Department of separation from service of Education Director
Fire extinguishers observed Not to be inspected or maintained at time of inspection.
Required food protection procedures were Not implemented at time of inspection. Holder of food protection certificate was Not on site during hours of food preparation activity.
Epi auto injector Not provided, Not maintained or expired.
